AIR RACER

BEST RUN — 0

PINCHEITHER HAND→ HOLD 1s: PAUSE/RESUME · RESTART AFTER CRASH
Steering, braking and boost are two-hand gestures — the run starts as soon as the camera is on. Acceleration is automatic (capped). Pass traffic closely to charge the boost bar — chain near misses quickly for a streak bonus; when the bar is full, pinch both hands to phase through traffic for 5s. Watch the radar up top for early warnings, and pause any time (P / ESC, or hold a one-hand pinch for 1 second) — the game auto-pauses when your hands leave the frame, and the same one-hand pinch brings you back.

Five vehicle classes share the road: sedans, sports cars, SUVs, box trucks and buses — each with its own speed. Themes rotate as you drive, Chrome-dino style. Camera tracking runs on-device — nothing is recorded or uploaded.

Radio (5 stations, all human-made): "Cool 80's Synth Wave" — Alex McCulloch (CC0); "Heartbreak" — nene ft. Dantastic (CC-BY 3.0); "Come Around" — p0ss (CC-BY-SA 3.0); "Glass Globe" & "Shoulder Angel" — Eric Taylor (CC-BY 3.0). Voice lines are synthetic (TTS). Stations auto-rotate every 30–60s like a GTA radio. Keyboard shortcuts (work any time): M mute music · K pause music · J/L previous / next track.
